Long live the nub: ThinkPad designer David Hill spills secrets, designs that never made it
4
We almost got more butterfly keyboards and foldable workstations
Avram Piltch
Sat 2 Aug 2025
//
11:32 UTC
Interview
Launched in 1992, the boxy black ThinkPad with its little red nub remains the quintessential business productivity notebook. Unlike commercial offerings from competitors such as Dell and HP, Lenovo's laptop has a following of people who collect old models and celebrate each new innovation.
If you bought a ThinkPad between 1995 and 2017, it was probably designed under the oversight of David W. Hill, who served as lead designer under both IBM and Lenovo for those 22 years. We caught up with Hill, who today runs his own firm, ThinkNext Design, to talk about the history of ThinkPad, what drove him to make key design decisions, and the products he wanted to come out with but just couldn't.
David Hill with a ThinkPad 701C
In a wide-ranging conversation, Hill revealed that he tried several times to introduce additional laptops that had the famous "butterfly keyboard" found on the ThinkPad 701C. He spoke about wanting to create a portable all-in-one desktop that would fold up like a laptop. And he explained the evolution of the TrackPoint nub and the ThinkLight overhead light.
Hill's career before ThinkPad
Hill started at IBM in 1985 and spent ten years working as an industrial designer on non-ThinkPad projects, including the company's AS/400, a mid-range computer (between a mainframe and a PC) that came out in 1988. At the time, most PCs were gray or beige.
"I led the design, most notably of IBM's AS/400 Advanced series. Which was all black, which was unbelievable in the world of servers at the time," he said. "It was all black and kind of menacing looking as some people said. But now you can hardly buy a server that's not black."
IBM AS/400. Image courtesy of Arnaud 25, Creative Commons 3.0
ThinkPad launches in 1992
The original ThinkPads, the 300, 700, and 700C, came out in October 1992, and were designed by IBM stalwarts Richard Sapper and Tom Hardy, with the idea that they would look like bento boxes. These were also the first laptops to use a pointing stick, the vaunted TrackPoint, which still appears on Lenovo's commercial laptops today. At this time, Hill was not yet on the team.
ThinkPad 700C, the first ThinkPad
"I thought it was brilliant, and I still think it is," Hill said of the nub. "You know, there's some people that don't like a TrackPoint, but I think a lot of those people probably never tried one."
Hill's first big project: The butterfly keyboard
Hill took over the design reins of ThinkPad in 1995, in time to launch the ThinkPad 701C and its unique keyboard mechanism. Unlike every other laptop, which has a keyboard the width or shorter than the lid above it, the 701C uses a butterfly-style keyboard that unfolds to become larger when the laptop is in use.
IBM ThinkPad 701C butterfly keyboard. Image by Raymangold22, Creative Commons 1.0
"There was always a mismatch between screen size and full-size keyboard. Because when the 701C came out, that was about the biggest screen you could make," he said of the laptop with its 10-inch display. "People forget about this, but it was very difficult to make a full-color screen that was really big. You wanted to have a full-size keyboard; you ended up with a huge border around the screen."
Hill worked with Sapper and engineer John Karidis on the idea of a foldable keyboard. But it was Karidis who came up with the game-changing butterfly concept.
"John Karidis had this brilliant idea that the way to solve this was inspired by wooden blocks. He had a daughter and they were playing with these wooden blocks and there's two blocks that are rectangles," Hill said. "So he went to work the next day with this 'aha' moment, and he put a keyboard from a ThinkPad on a copy machine and then cut it at a diagonal with a pair of scissors and put it back together in two different directions... And then he invented this mechanism to make it actually move when you've opened the display."
IBM ThinkPad 701C. Image by Ged Carroll, Creative Commons 2.0
Hill told
The Register
that he had wanted to make more ThinkPads with butterfly keyboards and had tried at least three times to make it happen – in one case there was a prototype where only half of the keyboard moved – but was never able to get there. Eventually, screens became big enough that there was no need to have a keyboard that expanded. However, Hill said, he thought about putting a butterfly keyboard on a netbook when they were a viable product category in the late aughts.
Changes to everyone's favorite nub
In addition to this work on ThinkPad keyboards, Hill also had influence over the design of the TrackPoint. The key improvements he oversaw were changes to the TrackPoint's red cap and its height.
"When I first started working on ThinkPad, [the TrackPoint] was rough, like it was called the 'cat tongue.'

• garciansmith怀念ThinkLight功能，认为其在黑暗环境中非常实用，而现代笔记本的背光键盘无法替代这一功能。
• michalpleban热爱Trackpoint功能，并表示不会回归使用鼠标，同时也提到可以通过外接USB键盘实现这一功能。
• raffael_de将ThinkPad设计视为经典，认为其超越了单纯的情怀，体现了功能至上的设计理念。
• penguin_booze对Lenovo键盘上的Fn键位置表示不满，认为Control键更符合用户习惯。
• scrlk回顾了ThinkPad历史上的一些创新设计，如双ThinkLight和副屏幕，并指出某些设计因实用性问题未能延续。
• dehrmann进一步指出，某些曾经的创新设计随着时间推移失去了意义，强调不应拘泥于过去的设计理念。

data.title: Cadence Guilty, Pays $140M for Exporting Semi Design Tools to PRC Military Uni
data.author: 737min
data.article_summary: 2025年7月28日，美国司法部和商务部宣布，Cadence Design Systems公司承认非法向中国国防科技大学（NUDT）出口半导体设计工具，将支付超过1.4亿美元的刑事和民事罚款。NUDT因涉及中国的军事模拟活动，被列入美国商务部的实体名单。Cadence通过其中国子公司，在未获必要许可下，向NUDT及其关联实体提供电子设计自动化（EDA）工具。助理司法部长Eisenberg强调，将严格执行出口管制法，保护美国技术优势。FBI反情报部门助理主任Rozhavsky指出，保护半导体产业对国家防御至关重要。Cadence已采取合规措施，防止未来再发生类似违法行为。

• [bobmcnamara] 对司法部对Cadence处以1.4亿美元罚款的效果表示质疑，认为罚款对Cadence这样的公司来说并不算重大影响。

• [rrrpdx1] 对Cadence当时的CEO以及董事会的尽职调查提出疑问，暗示高层可能没有充分履行职责，并指出该CEO目前可能在另一家公司担任要职。

• [akersten] 对受出口限制的EDA工具的具体内容表示好奇，并以KiCAD为例，质疑为何某些工具受限而其他类似工具则不受限制。

• [mensetmanusman] 以讽刺的语气建议用罚款建造公共设施，间接表达对罚款用途的不满。

• [raverbashing] 提出一个实际问题，即中国为何不使用"非官方"版本的软件，暗示可能存在规避出口限制的做法。

Cadence Design Systems Agrees to Plead Guilty and Pay Over $140 Million for Unlawfully Exporting Semiconductor Design Tools to a Restricted PRC Military University
Monday, July 28, 2025

The Counterintelligence and Export Control Section (CES) of the Justice Department’s National Security Division (NSD), and the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Northern District of California (NDCA) today announced that Cadence Design Systems Inc. (Cadence), a multinational electronic design automation (EDA) technology company headquartered in San Jose, California, has agreed to plead guilty to resolve charges that Cadence committed criminal violations of export controls by selling EDA hardware, software, and semiconductor design intellectual property (IP) technology to the National University of Defense Technology (NUDT).
NUDT, a university in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) under the leadership of the PRC’s Central Military Commission, was added to the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Entity List in February 2015 due to its use of U.S.-origin components to produce supercomputers believed to support nuclear explosive simulation and military simulation activities in the PRC.
Today, the Department filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California a criminal information charging Cadence with conspiracy to commit export control violations and the Department’s plea agreement with Cadence, pursuant to which the company has agreed to plead guilty and pay criminal penalties of nearly $118 million to resolve the charges.
In addition to the criminal charges, the U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) today
announced
the resolution of a parallel civil enforcement action against Cadence in which Cadence has agreed to pay over $95 million in civil penalties. The Department of Justice and BIS have coordinated the resolution of the parallel criminal and civil actions, with each agreeing to credit against their respective fines a portion of the payments made by Cadence to satisfy the other agency’s fine. After the Department of Justice and BIS credit payments made by Cadence under the coordinated agreements, Cadence will pay aggregate net criminal and civil penalties and forfeiture totaling more than $140 million.
“Cadence has agreed to accept responsibility for unlawfully exporting sensitive semiconductor design tools to a restricted Chinese military university and has implemented a strong export compliance program to help prevent any further illegal transmission of American technology,” said Assistant Attorney General for National Security John A. Eisenberg. “American ingenuity is one of our Nation’s most precious assets, and the National Security Division will vigorously enforce U.S. export control laws to protect the technological advantage we enjoy because of that ingenuity.”
“Export controls safeguard America’s advanced technological know-how from falling into the wrong hands, which is particularly important in the Silicon Valley as the epicenter of groundbreaking innovation,” said U.S. Attorney Craig H. Missakian for the Northern District of California. “With this plea, Cadence has admitted to unlawfully exporting its semiconductor design technology to a restricted PRC military university using a front company, and accepted responsibility for its wrongdoing. Cadence’s remedial measures are a positive step toward rectifying the company’s violations of export control laws and demonstrating corporate responsibility.”
“Protecting the U.S. semiconductor industry is critical to our national defense,” said Assistant Director Roman Rozhavsky of the FBI’s Counterintelligence Division. “Working with NUDT, which has been on the entity list for a decade for its work to advance China’s military capabilities, is unacceptable. The FBI will stop at nothing to defend the homeland from China’s Communist Party.”
According to Cadence’s admissions and court documents, from February 2015 to April 2021, Cadence and its indirectly owned and wholly controlled subsidiary in the PRC, Cadence Design Systems Management (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. (Cadence China), engaged in a conspiracy to commit export control violations in connection with the provision of EDA tools that were subject to the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) to NUDT through Central South CAD Center (CSCC), an alias for NUDT, and another associated entity, Phytium Technology Co. Ltd. (Phytium), without seeking or obtaining the requisite licenses from BIS. Specifically, Cadence, Cadence China, and their employees exported, reexported, and transferred in-country U.S.-origin EDA tools to CSCC in the PRC, despite having knowledge that CSCC was an alias for NUDT. data.title: Anandtech.com now redirects to its forums
data.author: kmfrk
data.article_summary: 这篇文章主要介绍了AnandTech论坛的各个板块及其最新讨论话题。论坛涵盖了硬件和技术的多个方面，包括CPU和超频、主板、显卡、内存与存储、显示器、电源供应、机箱与冷却、笔记本电脑、网络、苹果产品、外设与组件、电脑组装、消费电子、游戏主机、移动设备和音频组件等。每个板块列出了相关的讨论线程和消息数量，并展示了部分最新问题和讨论主题，如CPU架构比较、主板温度问题、显卡技术猜测、NVMe阵列设置建议、显示器选择等。此外，文章还提醒用户升级浏览器以获得最佳浏览体验，并邀请用户加入论坛参与讨论。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Anandtech网站停止更新及内容存档问题

不同观点：
• **支持存档和反对网站下线的观点**：
  - [kcb] 认为Anandtech数十年来的硬件评测内容变得不再易于访问，而下线决定是不必要的，因为这些内容只需少量努力即可继续托管，并通过广告产生收入。
  - [cnst] 指出网站仍能通过Google带来大量流量，质疑关闭网站的经济理由，并建议可以通过廉价的服务器继续托管内容。
  - [5pl1n73r] 对网站停止更新表示遗憾，认为这是旧网络的消亡，并指出Anandtech曾承诺内容将“无限期”保留。

• **对网站现状的描述和存档技术方案**：
  - [stuffoverflow] 提到Archiveteam对Anandtech进行了完整的站点抓取，用户可以通过replayweb.page或solrwayback浏览warc文件。
  - [dang] 提供了一个相关讨论链接，涉及AnandTech告别文章及大量评论。
  - [dangle1] 引用论坛成员的信息，指出存在一个存档。

• **对网站管理和技术能力的批评**：
  - [Aardwolf] 认为通常是网站论坛先消失，而非静态内容，因为论坛需要主动维护和审核。
  - [creatonez] 对技术人员无法保持简单的URL重定向表示不满。
  - [bananapub] 质问Anandtech是否未将CMS副本提供给Internet Archive。

补充讨论：
• **情感反应**：
  - [bwb] 和 [giantfrog] 对Anandtech的下线表示悲伤，认为这是网络的重大损失。
  
• **具体影响**：
  - [Numerlor] 提到因无法访问Anandtech上的评测文章而受到影响，显示出实际用户对内容消失的困扰。

争议焦点：
• 核心争议在于Anandtech在承诺无限期保留内容的情况下，仍然下线了主要内容页面，这引发了用户对其管理决策和技术执行的广泛质疑。

  - [bananapub] 质问Anandtech是否未将CMS副本提供给Internet Archive。

补充讨论：
• **情感反应**：
  - [bwb] 和 [giantfrog] 对Anandtech的下线表示悲伤，认为这是网络的重大损失。
  
• **具体影响**：
  - [Numerlor] 提到因无法访问Anandtech上的评测文章而受到影响，显示出实际用户对内容消失的困扰。

争议焦点：
• 核心争议在于Anandtech在承诺无限期保留内容的情况下，仍然下线了主要内容页面，这引发了用户对其管理决策和技术执行的广泛质疑。

不同观点：
• [hackpit] 认为Saturday Morning Cartoons具有特殊的文化意义，尤其是对那个时代的孩子而言。他强调了这不仅仅是因为节目本身，而是因为这是他们被允许看电视的有限时间，具有某种仪式感。这个时间段结束后，孩子们会被要求出去玩，直到晚餐时间才能回来。

• [1970-01-01] 关注技术的变革，认为ATSC 3.0技术的出现意味着地面广播和非直播节目即将消亡，就像AM广播一样。他的观点聚焦于技术进步对传统媒体消费形式的冲击，暗示Saturday Morning Cartoons这种固定时间段的节目形式将很快成为历史。

• [throawaywpg] 对Saturday Morning Cartoons的内容持批评态度，认为这些动画片大多只是玩具广告的延伸，质量不高，本质上是为了促销玩具等商品。这个观点质疑了这些节目的艺术和娱乐价值，认为它们更多是商业化的产物。

- 评论中涉及到的技术变革（ATSC 3.0）和对传统媒体形式的怀旧情感形成了对比，预示着媒体消费方式的转变。
- 对Saturday Morning Cartoons的评价存在争议，一部分人怀念其文化价值，而另一些人则批评其商业性质。

data.title: Tim Cook rallying Apple employees around AI efforts
data.author: andrew_lastmile
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Apple在人工智能（AI）技术整合和创新方面的表现和未来发展

不同观点：
• **Apple在AI领域的创新不足**：一些用户（如mensetmanusman）批评Apple在AI技术整合方面进展缓慢，认为早应允许用户将Siri替换为其他AI服务，且在功能实现上落后于竞争对手（如devinprater提到Google的TalkBack已有类似功能）。
• **对Apple保守策略的理解与批评**：部分评论（如lapcat和indy）质疑Apple高层的领导力，认为Tim Cook是维持现状的CEO，缺乏引领公司进入AI新时代的愿景和决策力。
• **技术实现的现实限制**：qrios指出，当前技术条件下，运行大型语言模型（LLM）需要强大的硬件支持，而移动设备要达到实时响应的需求仍需时间。不过，qrios对未来技术进步持乐观态度，认为通过软件优化和硬件提升，未来几年有可能实现突破。
• **Apple应开放AI平台**：mips_avatar建议Apple提供一个AI开发平台，让开发者在其基础上构建应用，从而推动AI技术在iPhone上的广泛应用。
• **对AI发展的抵触情绪**：hollerith表示因个人对AI发展的担忧，选择不购买Mac，并继续使用Linux系统，以抵制AI技术的快速推进。
• **优先修复现有问题**：dimal强调Apple应首先解决现有产品中的bug和功能问题，如iOS的预测文本和语音输入功能，认为这些基础功能尚未完善。

补充讨论：
• **Apple的保守策略可能导致落后**：unstatusthequo认为Apple的谨慎和缓慢推进策略可能导致在AI竞赛中处于追赶地位，错失早期市场优势。
• **Apple的收购策略**：shadowvoxing建议Apple可以通过收购像Mistral这样的公司迅速提升AI竞争力，从而在市场中占据有利位置。
• **对Steve Jobs时代的怀念**：andrewstuart认为如果是Steve Jobs领导，Apple可能已经设计出真正的机器人或更先进的AI技术，而不仅仅是当前表现不佳的Siri。

争议焦点：
• Apple是否在AI技术整合上过于保守，导致错失良机，以及是否应更积极地开放AI平台供开发者使用。

data.title: Replacing tmux in my dev workflow
data.author: elashri
data.article_summary:
文章讨论了作者对终端复用器 **tmux** 的长期使用体验，以及后来对 **tmux** 的一些反思和替代方案的探索。作者曾是 **tmux** 的忠实用户，因其提供的会话持久性、窗口管理（如分屏、标签页）等功能。然而，作者逐渐意识到 **tmux** 存在一些问题，如颜色渲染不准确、滚动条操作不便、对新协议支持不足等。这些问题在调试终端特性时尤为明显，尤其是通过 **SSH** 连接服务器时。

作者探讨了替代 **tmux** 的方案，包括 **ctrl-z + fg**、**nohup**、**disown** 等命令，但它们无法完全替代 **tmux** 的功能。随后，作者尝试了几个轻量级工具：**dtach**、**abduco** 和 **shpool**，它们专注于会话持久性，而非窗口管理。虽然这些工具在某些方面表现不错，但仍存在一些问题，如在 **nvim** 中无法正常 detach。最终，**shpool** 是作者的最佳选择，尽管仍有一些不足。

总结：作者反思了 **tmux** 的优缺点，并尝试了几个轻量级替代工具，最终认为 **shpool** 最符合需求，但仍不完美。

• pure-orange认为文章中的解决方案只是用其他工具重新实现了tmux的功能，建议应重新思考协议以使这些功能更原生化。
• WhyNotHugo分享了其从tmux转向i3wm/sway的经历，因其窗口管理器提供了类似功能，减少了对tmux的需求。
• GNOMES在本地使用中考虑用Ghostty替代tmux，但最终因个人偏好保留了tmux的状态栏设计。
• mickeyp建议使用Emacs作为终端多路复用器，提供了另一种选择。

补充讨论：
• tmux在不同平台（Linux、MacOS、Windows）上的表现和整合能力。
• tmux与其他工具（如Kitty、iTerm2、Emacs）的比较和结合使用。
• tmux的可编程性和在复杂工作流中的应用潜力。
• 个人对工具复杂性和功能性的不同偏好如何影响其对tmux的使用。

争议焦点：
• tmux是否增加了不必要的复杂性与其带来的功能是否值得之间的争论。
• 关于是否应重新设计协议以使终端工具更原生支持多路复用功能的讨论。

44754492.article_content:
Hear me out, I can already read the descenting opinions:
But I need session persistence!
But I need split windows!
But I need to group windows per project!
But I need lots of terminals inside of a remote server!
I had the exact same response whenever someone would argue against using
tmux
.
For context, I've been a huge fan of
tmux
and have been using it as a daily
part of my workflow for 7+ years. Whether I'm developing on my local machine or
in SSH, I was using
tmux
.
However, a couple of years ago I stumbled across a
GitHub issue in the kitty project
that has stuck in my mind like an itch that I cannot scratch.
In summary: multiplexers add unnecessary overhead, suffer from a complexity
cascade, because they actually have to
translate
escape codes, modifying
them in hackish ways to get them to work with their concepts of
windows/sessions.
And then a couple of weeks ago I watched this excellent interview from
linkarzu
and kovid (creator of kitty). In it, they
discussed
tmux
.
I have to say, the arguments are convincing. Over the years, I have had a
handful of problems with
tmux
that were not necessarily deal breakers but very
annoying to deal with on a regular basis.
For example, if you do not set
TERM
with
tmux
properly, your colors will
render incorrectly. Without
tmux
everything looks good, but with it things can
look washed out or just wrong. So when debugging issues related to terminal
features, you need to consider both your terminal emulator and
tmux
. Now add
another layer like
ssh
and you're really pulling your hair out.
Another example is buffer scrollback. It's one of those things where you have to
learn the
tmux
way of scrolling a window. You get used to it, of course, but
it's just not great.
And what about mouse select to copy/paste? It works most of the time, but
sometimes
tmux
gets ignored and I'm selecting across splits which makes the
thing I'm copying impossible to grab without bailing.
Another issue I ran into a couple of times is the lack of experimental protocol
support. I use "experimental" loosely since some of them are gaining popularity
inside terminal emulators, like the
kitty graphics protocol
.
Even if your terminal emulator supports the kitty graphics protocol,
tmux
does not
.
This is why kovid argues that terminal multiplexers:
"[...] act as a drag on the ecosystem as a whole, making it very hard to get
any new features."
Okay, I get it, I'm sympathetic to the issue terminal multiplexers cause to the
wider terminal ecosystem, but what's the alternative?
tmux
solves problems
that are not easy to replace:
session persistence (detach + attach process from terminal)
window management (tabs, splits, moving them around)
Session persistence can be accomplished in a number of ways, with varying
degrees of feature overlap with what
tmux
provides:
ctrl-z
+
fg
nohup {cmd} &
disown
These are discussed in this
stack exchange
post. None of them quite work the way
tmux
works. In particular, these
commands will either a) get killed when you close your terminal, or b) cannot
reattach easily.
For window management, the argument is we should use our window managers to
manipulate our windows. That works great for local development, but what happens
when you are SSH'd into a server? How do you let your window manager manipulate
windows within an SSH session?
Darn, built-in tools don't quite check all of our boxes, I wonder, are there any
tmux
alternatives that could work?
I was desperate for a solution and I really did not want to build my own. I also
didn't want to replace
tmux
with something equally as large of a dependency.
Here's what I found:
dtach
abduco
shpool
All of these tools embody the unix philosophy of doing one thing, well. So they
are targeting session persistence (detach and attach functionality). What's
exciting about this idea is since there are no virtual splits, I can get native
scrollback!
Most of them work by
creating a daemon
1
with some permutation of
fork()
and communicating with a unix socket between the detached process and "client"
terminals. Some of them support buffer playback so when you reattach you can see
where you left off. Most of them haven't quite nailed this aspect of what
tmux
does well, but
shpool
does a pretty good job.
I tried all of them with varying degrees of success. They could do what they
claim, but they are buggy. In particular, I could not get them to detach when
inside of
nvim
, which is a deal breaker. I assumed it was because the
shortcuts I was using to detach were being captured by
nvim
. Who knows, it
might be something misconfigured on my end.
However, out of those tools I used,
shpool
checked the most boxes.
Specifically they have a command
shpool detach
which allowed me to run a
command to detach the current process. So I was able to create a keymap that
sent the detach command to
shpool
:
1
-- https://github.com/shell-pool/shpool/issues/71#issuecomment-2632396805
2
vim.keymap
.
set
({
"n"
,
"v"
,
"i"
,
"t"
},
"<C-space><C-d>"
,
function

• d4rkp4ttern强调tmux的可编程性，分享了如何利用tmux实现与CLI脚本的交互，并创建了一个工具Tmux-cli来实现此功能，展示了tmux的潜在应用。
• JdeBP指出，设置TERM不正确会导致颜色等问题，但这不是tmux特有的问题，而是所有终端仿真器共有的现实。
• wkat4242支持tmux，认为其在旧设备如VT520上仍能有效工作，并认为是否优雅不重要，关键在于是否适合个人需求。
• nickjj继续支持tmux，强调其在管理多个会话和项目切换上的便利性，并分享了其使用tmux进行配置文件批量处理的经验。
• plett将tmux与浏览器标签页类比，认为当处理多个终端会话时，tmux的类似功能不可或缺。
• meitham分享了其在使用Kitty时遇到的问题，并通过tmux解决了这些问题，强调了tmux在跨终端工作中的重要性。
• FergusArgyll指出tmux在处理滚动和复制粘贴上的问题，但正因为这些特性，使其在无鼠标环境下的使用尤为有效。
• esjeon提到suckless社区的终端工具采取了与tmux相反的简约设计哲学。
• sevensor认为Kitty在推动终端仿真器进步方面表现出色，但在工作环境中仍需依赖tmux来保持工作流的连续性。
• pure-orange认为文章中的解决方案只是用其他工具重新实现了tmux的功能，建议应重新思考协议以使这些功能更原生化。
• WhyNotHugo分享了其从tmux转向i3wm/sway的经历，因其窗口管理器提供了类似功能，减少了对tmux的需求。
• GNOMES在本地使用中考虑用Ghostty替代tmux，但最终因个人偏好保留了tmux的状态栏设计。
• mickeyp建议使用Emacs作为终端多路复用器，提供了另一种选择。

补充讨论：
• tmux在不同平台（Linux、MacOS、Windows）上的表现和整合能力。
• tmux与其他工具（如Kitty、iTerm2、Emacs）的比较和结合使用。
• tmux的可编程性和在复杂工作流中的应用潜力。
• 个人对工具复杂性和功能性的不同偏好如何影响其对tmux的使用。

争议焦点：
• tmux是否增加了不必要的复杂性与其带来的功能是否值得之间的争论。
• 关于是否应重新设计协议以使终端工具更原生支持多路复用功能的讨论。

Ex-CISA chief slams MAGA 'manufactured outrage' after sudden West Point firing

US Army Sec appears to fold under pressure from far-right conspiracy theorist
Jessica Lyons
Thu 31 Jul 2025

Jen Easterly has weighed in on the US Army Secretary firing her from a prestigious West Point teaching post a day after the US Military Academy announced the appointment.
The termination, announced — where else — on X by Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, seemingly proves the former CISA chief's comments about loyalty to the president taking precedence over loyalty to the nation.
In a lengthy LinkedIn
post
on Thursday, the former US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) chief said "the opportunity to serve again at my alma mater was rescinded — a casualty of casually manufactured outrage that drowned out the quiet labor of truth and the steady pulse of integrity."
Easterly, who described herself as a "lifelong independent" and noted her military and public service under both Republican and Democratic administrations, said she has "worked my entire career not as a partisan, but as a patriot — not in pursuit of power, but in service to the country I love and in loyalty to the Constitution I swore to protect and defend, against all enemies."
She added, this isn't about her. "This is about something larger," Easterly wrote:
It's about the sacred trust we place in those who wear the uniform — and the damage threatened when that trust is eroded by partisanship. The U.S. military — including its academies — must remain an institution above politics, grounded in service to the Constitution. When outrage is weaponized and truth discarded, it tears at the fabric of unity and undermines the very ethos that draws brave young men and women to serve and sacrifice: Duty, Honor, Country.
Two days earlier, in a
now-deleted
LinkedIn post, the US Military Academy at West Point announced that Easterly would
return to the academy
as a Robert F. McDermott Distinguished Chair in West Point's Department of Social Sciences, where she previously taught economics and national security.
Soon after, far-right conspiracy theorist Laura Loomer
criticized Easterly's appointment
on X, posting: "Why are Biden holdovers who worked to silence Trump supporters under Biden getting elevated to high level jobs under the Trump admin?"
On Wednesday, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll
fired Easterly
before she even began her new gig. "I have immediately directed West Point to…Rescind Jen Easterly's offer to serve as the McDermott Chair," Driscoll xeeted.
When asked why Driscoll rescinded Easterly's appointment, and whether it was related to Loomer's attacks on social media, a US Army spokesperson emailed
The Register
the following statement:
The Secretary of the Army took immediate action to direct West Point to terminate the service agreement with Jen Easterly, pause outside groups from selecting Academy employees or instructors, and has requested a review of West Point's hiring practices.
Ahead of the upcoming academic year, we are crafting a deliberate approach to ensure that our future officers are best prepared to meet the demands of the modern battlefield.
The statement doesn't answer either of our questions. But if we had to guess, we'd say Easterly was fired because as CISA director, she advocated for election security, which includes
securing voting infrastructure
and
fighting online disinformation
, both the kind that originates from Russian troll farms and the home-grown kind.
Easterly's predecessor, Chris Krebs, spoke out against the latter kind and also faced the wrath of the Trump administration.
Krebs, a Republican who Trump appointed to lead the CISA in 2018, was
fired via tweet
five years ago after he publicly contradicted Trump's false claims of election fraud, describing the 2020 US presidential election "the most secure in American history."
Ex-CISA chief decries cuts as Trump demands loyalty above all else
Trump kills clearances for infosec's SentinelOne, ex-CISA boss Chris Krebs
CISA: Wow, that election had a lot of foreign trolling. Trump's Homeland Sec pick: And that's none of your concern
Ex-CISA employee: 'This culture of fear started permeating the agency'
In April, Krebs became the target of a
Department of Justice probe
and an executive order accusing him of using CISA to pursue a "partisan mission" and covering up alleged proof that "the 2020 election was rigged and stolen." Krebs, along with all of his
former SentinelOne co-workers
, also had their security clearances revoked.
Now with Easterly's apparent blackballing, both of CISA's former directors have landed on Trump's hit list. Perhaps current nominee
Sean Plankey
, slated to become CISA's third boss since the first Trump administration created the cyber agency, should reconsider.
The Army Secretary's moves also reminded us of Easterly's concerns about
CISA being gutted
due to a "mandate for loyalty to a person over loyalty to the Cons

data.title: New research finds that ivermectin could help control malaria transmission
data.author: rguiscard
data.article_summary: 新研究发现，伊维菌素（原本用于治疗被忽视的热带病）可以有效帮助控制疟疾传播。在一项涉及肯尼亚和莫桑比克的大规模试验中，伊维菌素使肯尼亚5-15岁儿童的疟疾新感染率降低了26%。该研究由巴塞罗那全球健康研究所和KEMRI-Wellcome信托研究项目合作进行，结果发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上。伊维菌素通过杀死吸取受治疗者血液的蚊子来减少疟疾传播，特别是在传统方法如蚊帐和杀虫剂因蚊子抗药性而效果减弱的情况下，提供了一种新的补充策略。尽管莫桑比克的试验因自然灾害受到影响，整体结果显示伊维菌素在疟疾防控方面有很大潜力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：伊维菌素（Ivermectin）的功效、应用及其在科学和公众舆论中的争议

不同观点：
• **kacesensitive**：伊维菌素有有趣的起源和广泛的应用，特别是在治疗寄生虫疾病方面，如河盲症。然而，它并非如某些宣传所称的万能药。其祖父因受媒体广告影响而囤积此药，表明公众可能对此药物有误解。

• **amluto**：伊维菌素不仅能治疗寄生虫感染，还能通过杀死蚊子减少疟疾的传播。这可能会影响随机对照试验的设计，因为药物对蚊子的杀伤作用可能干扰感染传播的评估。文章指出，研究人员通过随机整群分配来解决这一问题。

• **vnchr**：伊维菌素的发现者在2015年获得了诺贝尔奖，同年还有一位新的疟疾治疗方法的发现者获奖，这是一种有趣的巧合，突显了伊维菌素在医学上的重要性。

• **rolph**：伊维菌素并不能阻止人类感染疾病，但通过使血液对蚊子有毒来减少蚊子数量，从而间接减少疾病的传播。

• **walterbell**：提供信息表明，美国有四个州已经通过了非处方伊维菌素法律，另有九个州正在推动相关立法，显示出该药物在公共卫生政策中的争议和讨论。

• **raffael_de**：以讽刺的方式质疑伊维菌素作为马用驱虫药的身份，并提到CNN等媒体的报道，暗示公众对该药物的看法可能受到媒体的强烈影响。

• **OutOfHere**：对一项研究提出质疑，认为伊维菌素每月一次的剂量不足以维持药效，并建议更频繁的剂量可能会提高其效果。

补充讨论：
• 伊维菌素在疟疾等疾病传播中的潜在作用引起了对其试验设计的关注，尤其是在随机对照试验中如何处理药物对蚊子的影响。
• 公众和媒体对伊维菌素的看法存在分歧，一些人因其诺贝尔奖背景而对其高度评价，另一些人则因其兽医用途而质疑其在人类医学中的应用。
• 立法层面的变化显示出伊维菌素在公共卫生政策中的争议性地位，不同州对其非处方使用的法律规定反映了这一点。
• 对伊维菌素剂量和药效关系的讨论突显了科学界对该药物实际应用效果的不同看法。

New research finds that ivermectin could help control malaria transmission
New research finds that ivermectin could help control malaria transmission
Share
Share
Share
Publications & research news
24 July 2025
A collaborative new study involving KEMRI-Wellcome Trust researchers has highlighted a new way to control malaria transmission. The study found that ivermectin, a drug normally used for neglected tropical diseases, led to a 26% reduction in new malaria infections among children aged 5-15.
©
Life Spark Studios
Malaria remains a global health challenge, with
263 million cases and
597,000 deaths reported in 2023. Current vector control methods, such as long-lasting insecticidal nets and indoor residual spraying, have become less effective due to insecticide resistance and behavioural adaptations in mosquitoes to bite outdoors and during dusk or dawn, when people are not protected by these measures. This underscores the urgent need for innovative solutions to combat malaria.
The BOHEMIA trial, the largest study on ivermectin for malaria to date, showed a 26% reduction in new malaria infection on top of existing bed nets,
providing strong evidence of ivermectin’s potential as a complementary tool in malaria control. Coordinated by the Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) - an institution supported by the “la Caixa” Foundation - in collaboration with the Manhiça Health Research Centre and the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, the study has been published in
The New England Journal of Medicine.
Ivermectin is a drug traditionally used to treat neglected tropical diseases like onchocerciasis which causes river blindness and lymphatic filariasis which causes elephantiasis. It has now been shown to reduce malaria transmission by killing the mosquitoes that feed on treated individuals. Given the rising resistance to conventional insecticides, ivermectin could offer an effective new approach to
tackle malaria transmission, especially in regions where traditional methods have become less effective.
The Unitaid-funded
BOHEMIA project
(Broad One Health Endectocide-based Malaria Intervention in Africa) conducted two Mass Drug Administration (MDA) trials in the high-burden malaria regions: Kwale County (Kenya) and Mopeia district (Mozambique). The trials assessed the safety and efficacy of a single monthly dose of ivermectin (400 mcg/kg) given for three consecutive months at the start of the rainy season in reducing malaria transmission. In Kenya, the intervention targeted children aged 5–15, while in Mozambique it focused on children under five.
In Kwale County, Kenya, children who received ivermectin experienced a 26% reduction in malaria infection incidence
compared to those who received the control drug. The trial involved over 20,000 participants and more than 56,000 treatments, demonstrating that ivermectin significantly reduced malaria infection rates—particularly among children living further from cluster borders or in areas where drug distribution was more efficient. Moreover, the safety profile of ivermectin was favourable, with no severe drug-related adverse events and only mild, transient side effects already seen with ivermectin in campaigns against neglected tropical diseases.
Professor
Marta Maia
, Associate Professor at the
Centre for Tropical Medicine and Global Health
and Medical Entomologist based at the
KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme
, said: ‘The findings suggest that
ivermectin MDA could be a valuable complementary strategy for malaria control, particularly in areas where mosquito resistance to insecticides is a growing concern.’
Dr
Joseph Mwangangi
, Senior Principal Research Scientist at the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, added: ‘These results align with the World Health Organization’s (WHO) criteria for new vector control tools.’
Carlos Chaccour, co-principal investigator of the BOHEMIA project said: ‘We are thrilled with these results. Ivermectin has shown great promise in reducing malaria transmission and could complement existing control measures. With continued research, ivermectin MDA could become an effective tool for malaria control and even contribute to elimination efforts.’
In contrast, the implementation of the Mozambique trial in the rural district of Mopeia faced severe disruptions due to Cyclone Gombe in 2022 and a subsequent cholera outbreak, which significantly disrupted operations.
Francisco Saúte, dir

• **kacesensitive**：伊维菌素有有趣的起源和广泛的应用，特别是在治疗寄生虫疾病方面，如河盲症。然而，它并非如某些宣传所称的万能药。其祖父因受媒体广告影响而囤积此药，表明公众可能对此药物有误解。

• **amluto**：伊维菌素不仅能治疗寄生虫感染，还能通过杀死蚊子减少疟疾的传播。这可能会影响随机对照试验的设计，因为药物对蚊子的杀伤作用可能干扰感染传播的评估。文章指出，研究人员通过随机整群分配来解决这一问题。

• **vnchr**：伊维菌素的发现者在2015年获得了诺贝尔奖，同年还有一位新的疟疾治疗方法的发现者获奖，这是一种有趣的巧合，突显了伊维菌素在医学上的重要性。

• **rolph**：伊维菌素并不能阻止人类感染疾病，但通过使血液对蚊子有毒来减少蚊子数量，从而间接减少疾病的传播。

• **walterbell**：提供信息表明，美国有四个州已经通过了非处方伊维菌素法律，另有九个州正在推动相关立法，显示出该药物在公共卫生政策中的争议和讨论。

• **raffael_de**：以讽刺的方式质疑伊维菌素作为马用驱虫药的身份，并提到CNN等媒体的报道，暗示公众对该药物的看法可能受到媒体的强烈影响。

• **OutOfHere**：对一项研究提出质疑，认为伊维菌素每月一次的剂量不足以维持药效，并建议更频繁的剂量可能会提高其效果。

补充讨论：
• 伊维菌素在疟疾等疾病传播中的潜在作用引起了对其试验设计的关注，尤其是在随机对照试验中如何处理药物对蚊子的影响。
• 公众和媒体对伊维菌素的看法存在分歧，一些人因其诺贝尔奖背景而对其高度评价，另一些人则因其兽医用途而质疑其在人类医学中的应用。
• 立法层面的变化显示出伊维菌素在公共卫生政策中的争议性地位，不同州对其非处方使用的法律规定反映了这一点。
• 对伊维菌素剂量和药效关系的讨论突显了科学界对该药物实际应用效果的不同看法。

data.title: Shroud of Turin image matches low-relief statue–not human body, study finds
data.author: politelemon
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了都灵裹尸布（Shroud of Turin）图像的最新研究成果。通过使用3D建模软件（如MakeHuman、Blender和CloudCompare），研究比较了裹尸布上的图像与三维人体模型和低浮雕艺术模型在平面布料上的印痕。结果显示，裹尸布图像与低浮雕模型的印痕更吻合，表明图像可能并非直接来自人体，而是一件中世纪的艺术作品。这一发现支持了都灵裹尸布是中世纪艺术品的理论，而非耶稣基督的裹尸布。虽然研究未涉及裹尸布的年代测定，但强调了数字技术在解决历史谜题方面的潜力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：两件著名的圣像文物——都灵裹尸布和瓜达卢佩圣母像的神秘特征及其真实性讨论

不同观点：
• 支持都灵裹尸布真实性的观点：
  - 科学和法医证据表明，裹尸布上的图像是通过现代技术无法复制的复杂微观纤维形成的，且没有颜料或笔触痕迹。
  - 血液分析显示图上血型为AB型，含有高浓度的胆红素，符合严重受虐致死的情况。
  - 裹尸布上的血迹和伤口与被钉十字架的受害者一致，伤口类型与罗马刑具吻合。
  - 图像包含三维信息，这是普通二维绘画或照片无法实现的。
  - 裹尸布上发现的尘土和花粉来自巴勒斯坦、南土耳其和中东，支持其历史路径。
  - 硬币图像与公元29-36年间由本丢彼拉多铸造的硬币有24处吻合，符合犹太葬礼习俗。

• 支持瓜达卢佩圣母像真实性的观点：
  - 红外摄影显示图像没有底稿，16世纪艺术家不可能在没有底稿情况下完成如此复杂的图像。
  - 图像在粗糙的仙人掌纤维上保存超过481年，没有褪色或裂痕，且经历过化学品和爆炸仍完好无损。
  - 图像上的星星与1531年12月12日的冬季天空星座精确对应，花朵与墨西哥的火山位置对应。
  - 圣母眼睛中反射的微小图像符合人类眼睛反射规律，并包含疑似目击者的人群影像。
  - 图像的视觉效果在不同距离上变化，象征不同种族的团结，类似于蝴蝶或甲虫翅膀的色彩效果。
  - 图像温度保持在36.5°C，与人体正常温度一致，无论环境如何变化。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点：
  - 对于都灵裹尸布，反对者质疑中世纪伪造者是否可能通过未知方法伪造部分特征。
  - 对于瓜达卢佩圣母像，怀疑者对图像的神奇耐久性和温度自控特性表示怀疑，认为可能存在自然或未解的科学现象。
  - 两件文物的超自然特性引发科学界和宗教界的持续争论，特别是关于是否存在现代科学无法解释的古代技术或神秘干预。

August 2, 2025
report
The GIST
Shroud of Turin image matches low-relief statue—not human body, 3D modeling study finds
by
Krystal Kasal
, Phys.org
edited by
Andrew Zinin
Editors' notes
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's
editorial process
and
policies
.
Editors
have highlighted
the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:
fact-checked
peer-reviewed publication
trusted source
proofread
(A) Overlay of the texture generated by the 3D model onto the image of the Shroud of Turin, showing misalignment in anatomical proportions. (B) Original image of the Shroud. (C) Overlay of the texture generated by the low-relief model, demonstrating greater compatibility with the Shroud image, especially in the torso and head regions. Credit:
Archaeometry
(2025). DOI: 10.1111/arcm.70030
The Shroud of Turin is a famous artifact with obscure origins. How and when it was made has long been the subject of debate among many scientists, historians and religious leaders, alike. The two most prominent theories are that it was either created as a work of art during the medieval period or that it was a piece of linen that was actually wrapped around the body of Jesus Christ after his death over 2000 years ago.
Radiocarbon dating done in a
1989 study
on the Shroud of Turin dated it around 1260 to 1390 AD, consistent with the medieval theory. Later, in 2005, Raymond Rogers argued that the tested sample from the
radiocarbon dating
came from an area that had been repaired, and was thus newer than the original cloth. And more recently,
in 2022
, a single thread from the shroud material was tested with a new—and somewhat controversial—method based on Wide Angle X-ray Scattering (WAXS), which claimed that the shroud dated back to the first century AD. If those results are reliable, this dates the cloth much closer to the time of Jesus.
Yet
another study
examined the blood patterns on the shroud and deemed them inconsistent with what would be expected with a deceased man lying flat. In fact, the authors stated that these blood patterns were "totally unrealistic." This led to the idea that the blood might have been added to the shroud in a more artistic manner after its creation.
Recently, a study using 3D modeling with MakeHuman, Blender and CloudCompare has added more evidence to the debate. The study,
published
in
Archaeometry
, compares digital imprints of a three dimensional human figure and a low-relief artistic rendering—similar to a flattened statue—of a human onto a flat sheet.
(A) Comparison between the contact patterns generated by the three-dimensional model (right) and the low-relief model (left), in an oblique orthographic view. It is noted that the three-dimensional model results in a distorted projection, with more robust body features. (B) Top view of the same simulations, highlighting differences in the contact area: smaller in the 3D model and broader in the low-relief model. Credit:
Archaeometry
(2025). DOI: 10.1111/arcm.70030
The idea is that when a 3D object is wrapped with a 2D sheet, like a piece of cloth, the resulting imprint is distorted and appears to be much wider than when you look straight at the 3D object. This somewhat intuitive outcome is referred to as the Agamemnon Mask effect. The Agamemnon Mask is a gold funerary mask discovered at the Bronze Age site of Mycenae in Greece that looked like it had been rolled out flat after fitting to a face.
The digital imprint on the 2D surface which had been laid out on the 3D human figure appeared widened and distorted, as expected, unlike the imprint on the real Shroud of Turin. Instead, the low-relief model produced an imprint much more consistent with the Shroud's actual appearance.
Cicero Moraes, the study author, writes, "The contact pattern generated by the low-relief model is more compatible with the Shroud's image, showing less anatomical distortion and greater fidelity to the observed contours, while the projection of a 3D body results in a significantly distorted image."
Simulation of the fabric. Top part: Top view with the fabric mesh positioned over the body. Bottom part: Side view of the fabric simulation draped over the body. Credit:
Archaeometry
(2025). DOI: 10.1111/arcm.70030
While this study does not give any particular insight into the dating of the Shroud of Turin, it does provide support to the idea that it was an artistic rendering. Low-relief art was also common during the
medieval period
, so this type of creation aligns with what might have been done during that time.
Moraes encourages others to test out the free and accessible software used in the study to replicate the results or delve deeper into other historical curiosities. He says, "This work not only offers another perspective on the origin of the Shroud of Turin's image but also highlights the potential of digital technologies to address or unravel historical mysteries, intertwining science, art, and technology in a collaborative and reflective searc

data.title: 150 years of Hans Christian Andersen
data.author: wholeness
data.article_summary: 《丑小鸭》是安徒生1843年发表的童话，带有自传色彩。故事讲述了一只因丑陋而被排斥的鸭子，最终变成美丽天鹅的历程，反映了安徒生作为局外人的成长经历。安徒生出身贫寒，父亲是鞋匠，母亲是文盲洗衣妇，他从小性格孤僻，喜欢自编自演木偶剧。尽管因外貌丑陋常遭嘲笑，但他通过讲述充满孤独与伟大的故事获得了成功。安徒生的许多作品，如《坚定的锡兵》和《卖火柴的小女孩》，都反映了他对社会残酷的感知以及对自我命运的思考。他的一生充满坎坷，但也如同童话般最终实现了自我成就。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对安徒生作品及其生平的评价与讨论

不同观点：
• [agys] 喜欢安徒生不那么出名的一些故事，尤其是那些以物品或昆虫为主角的故事。这些故事往往通过最后一句话引入一个反转，具有深刻的内心独白，如针、硬币、茶壶、树和蝴蝶等角色。
• [Systemic33] 认为安徒生的作品常被视为儿童故事，但其实很多并不适合儿童，因为许多故事非常悲伤，角色命运往往在最后出人意料地变糟。他的作品深刻而富有哲理。
• [dang] 强调安徒生的生平故事充满艰辛，他的经历如同狄更斯小说中的角色。安徒生自认为与众不同，甚至像是从天而降的存在。评论还提到有人认为安徒生可能有发育障碍如运动障碍（dyspraxia）。
• [mths] 对安徒生外貌的负面描述表示怀疑，认为从一些肖像画来看，安徒生长相正常。
• [jyounker] 提到安徒生是个糟糕的客人，并分享了一个关于此的游戏链接。
• [coreyh14444] 指出丹麦人对安徒生的崇拜，街头巷尾都有他的雕像和以他命名的街道。
• [nurettin] 分享了一个关于安徒生的有趣故事，讲述他如何在雪夜将马拴在柱子上，结果醒来发现雪融化后马挂在教堂屋顶的十字架上。
• [PeterStuer] 回忆安徒生和格林兄弟的童话是其童年的一部分。

补充讨论：
• [erk__] 提供了一个包含安徒生所有作品的网站链接，方便读者查阅他的作品（丹麦语和英语）。
• [danneezhao] 提到长大后意识到童话故事几乎是谎言，王子和公主很难永远幸福生活。

争议焦点：
• 安徒生作品是否适合儿童阅读：[agys] 和 [Systemic33] 的观点形成对比，前者关注安徒生不为人知的故事及其艺术性，后者则强调其作品中不适合儿童的悲伤和反转结局。
• 安徒生的外貌描述是否准确：[dang] 和 [mths] 之间存在争议，前者引用了狄更斯对安徒生的描述，后者则质疑这种描述的真实性。

44739494.article_content:
There once was an ugly duckling, so despised by the other birds that he fled the farm to explore the wider world. But because of his very great ugliness he was taunted there too, until one day he caught his image reflected in a pond and he had turned into a beautiful swan.
The Ugly Duckling
, first published in 1843, was one of Hans Christian Andersen’s many autobiographical fairy tales: “It matters nothing if one is born in a duck-yard,” he wrote, “if one has lain in a swan’s egg.”
Andersen’s subject, from the start, was the outsider destined for greatness. “At school,” he recalled in
The Fairy Tale of My Life
, the third of his three memoirs, “I told the boys curious stories in which I was always the chief person, but was sometimes ridiculed for that.” His stories were miniature epics (
The Princess and the Pea
is 300 words long) and his characters, like the author himself, solitary figures of spiritual greatness for whom the world is a place of inexplicable cruelty. Other versions of Anderson’s life can be found in his first published fairy tale,
The Tinderbox,
in which a clever soldier discovers the magic formula for wealth and success;
The Steadfast Tin Soldier,
in which a one-legged, love-sick toy falls from a window, is swallowed by a fish, and then thrown into a stove where he melts into a heart-shaped lump; and
The Little Match Girl
, where a frozen, homeless child, on her last night on Earth, gazes through a window at a happy bourgeois family.
Had Anderson been as handsome as Danny Kaye, who played him in the Hollywood musical
Hans Christian Andersen
(1952), he would not have become a teller of tales. It was his fabulous ugliness that fuelled his ambition. “I shall have no success with my appearance,” he reflected, “so I make use of whatever is available.”
Everyone who met him remarked on his appearance. As a 20-year-old student in Copenhagen, he was described as “a lanky figure in a worn-out grey coat whose sleeves did not reach his emaciated wrists”. As a 40-year-old celebrity in a London drawing-room, he was described as “long, thin, fleshless, boneless… wriggling and bending like a lizard with a lantern-jawed, cadaverous visage”. He described himself in one of his poems as having a nose “as mighty as a cannon” and eyes as “tiny” as “green peas”. Edmund Gosse was “almost painfully struck… by the grotesque ugliness of his face and hands, and by his enormously long and swinging arms”. Anderson’s friend William Bloch also recalled his “out of proportion” arms and legs, together with his “broad and flat” hands, and “feet of such gigantic dimensions” that no one would ever steal his boots.
Added to this were what Bloch called Anderson’s “strange and bizarre” movements, and others noted his “ludicrous” manners and “obsequious contortions”, including deep theatrical bows. Heinrich Heine, the living writer Anderson most admired, mistook him for “a tailor” because of his “fawning servility”. If he sounds like a character invented by Charles Dickens, it is because Uriah Heep was modelled on Andersen, whom Dickens met in 1847. David Copperfield’s first sighting of Heep was “a cadaverous face” peering out of the round tower: “He had a way of writhing when he wanted to express enthusiasm, which was very ugly, the snaky twistings of his throat and body.” “If you’re an eel, sir,” counsels Betsey Trotwood, “conduct yourself like one. If you’re a man, control your limbs, sir!” In our own kinder age, we might diagnose Anderson with dyspraxia.
The life of Andersen was indeed the stuff of fairy tales. He was born in 1805 in a one-room cottage in the poorest part of Odense, a town on the Danish island of Funen rich in folk heritage. His father was a cobbler whose workshop was also in the cottage, and his mother was an illiterate washerwoman; his aunt ran a brothel, and his grandfather was insane. As a boy, Andersen watched the old man carve wooden figures with beasts’ heads, which he then gave to the village children. It was in the spinning room of the asylum where his grandmother was employed that he first heard the fairy tales that transfixed him, and when, on forest walks, his father told him tales from
The Arabian Nights
, Andersen knew he was destined to be another Scheherazade.
Andersen, a dreamy and effeminate only child, preferred his own company. His favourite pastime was the toy theatre made by his father, for which he wrote plays to be performed by the dolls whose clothes he designed and sewed. His first production was a tragedy taken from a song in
Pyramus and Thisbe
, the play within the play performed by the mechanicals in A
Midsummer Night’s Dream
. “Everyone was obliged to hear my play,” Anderson recalled in his first memoir,
The True Story of My Life
, written when he was 27 and not yet a household name. “It was a perfect treat for me to read it, and it never occurred to me that my audience might not experience the same pleasure in listening.” Anderson’s performances were mocked by the street boys

不同观点：
• [agys] 喜欢安徒生不那么出名的一些故事，尤其是那些以物品或昆虫为主角的故事。这些故事往往通过最后一句话引入一个反转，具有深刻的内心独白，如针、硬币、茶壶、树和蝴蝶等角色。
• [Systemic33] 认为安徒生的作品常被视为儿童故事，但其实很多并不适合儿童，因为许多故事非常悲伤，角色命运往往在最后出人意料地变糟。他的作品深刻而富有哲理。
• [dang] 强调安徒生的生平故事充满艰辛，他的经历如同狄更斯小说中的角色。安徒生自认为与众不同，甚至像是从天而降的存在。评论还提到有人认为安徒生可能有发育障碍如运动障碍（dyspraxia）。
• [mths] 对安徒生外貌的负面描述表示怀疑，认为从一些肖像画来看，安徒生长相正常。
• [jyounker] 提到安徒生是个糟糕的客人，并分享了一个关于此的游戏链接。
• [coreyh14444] 指出丹麦人对安徒生的崇拜，街头巷尾都有他的雕像和以他命名的街道。
• [nurettin] 分享了一个关于安徒生的有趣故事，讲述他如何在雪夜将马拴在柱子上，结果醒来发现雪融化后马挂在教堂屋顶的十字架上。
• [PeterStuer] 回忆安徒生和格林兄弟的童话是其童年的一部分。

补充讨论：
• [erk__] 提供了一个包含安徒生所有作品的网站链接，方便读者查阅他的作品（丹麦语和英语）。
• [danneezhao] 提到长大后意识到童话故事几乎是谎言，王子和公主很难永远幸福生活。

争议焦点：
• 安徒生作品是否适合儿童阅读：[agys] 和 [Systemic33] 的观点形成对比，前者关注安徒生不为人知的故事及其艺术性，后者则强调其作品中不适合儿童的悲伤和反转结局。
• 安徒生的外貌描述是否准确：[dang] 和 [mths] 之间存在争议，前者引用了狄更斯对安徒生的描述，后者则质疑这种描述的真实性。

data.title: Raspberry Pi 5 Gets a MicroSD Express Hat
data.author: geerlingguy
data.article_summary: Will Whang开发的RPI5-SDexpress-Hat是一款适用于Raspberry Pi 5的扩展板，增加了microSD Express卡槽，支持高速存储，同时具备弹出按钮和两个Qwiic连接器。microSD Express卡通过PCIe接口和NVMe命令提供SSD级性能，但目前支持的硬件较少。任天堂Switch 2是首款大规模采用microSD Express卡槽的设备，这也是该HAT的开发动机。该板使用WCH CH32V003 RISC-V微控制器，通过PCIe Gen3 x1接口连接，并提供良好的存储性能，读取速度超过630MB/s。然而，由于microSD Express卡成本较高，目前在Raspberry Pi 5上使用并不划算，M.2 NVMe SSD更为经济。设计已开源，任何人都可根据需要生产。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Raspberry Pi 5的优缺点及其与其他迷你PC的比较

不同观点：
• JdeBP认为Raspberry Pi 5在软件支持方面存在不足，缺乏对TianoCore、NetBSD、FreeBSD、OpenBSD和OmniOS(CE)等操作系统的支持，这使其在现有硬件支持上有所退步。他质疑该产品是否会在软件支持上有所改善。
• codeflo持较为积极的态度，认为尽管Raspberry Pi在价格和性能对比上受到批评，但其独特的“魔法”和GPIO引脚等特性使其在爱好者和实验项目中依然具有吸引力。
• Havoc对Raspberry Pi 5的存在意义提出质疑，建议如果使用PCIe通道，应直接使用M.2接口以利用NVMe驱动器的大规模生产优势，并表达了对SD卡可靠性的不信任。
• thekevan表示由于迷你PC在价格和规格上的竞争力，已经对Raspberry Pi失去兴趣。
• zerof1l认为应避免使用SD卡，建议使用M.2或NVMe存储，以提高性能和可靠性。
• nottorp建议Raspberry Pi 5默认配备M.2插槽，以保持小型化设计的同时提升存储性能。
• qwertox关注MicroSD Express的PCIe支持和散热问题，希望看到相关性能基准测试。
• schappim从商业角度强调SD卡存储的不可靠性，认为使用M.2 HAT和SSD是显著提升Raspberry Pi 5可靠性的关键，并认为其价格合理。
• Veliladon指出目前难以购买到合适的存储卡。
• _giorgio_提出一个具体应用场景，询问适合的板卡和摄像头组合，以实现远程访问的网络摄像头实验。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是Raspberry Pi 5的存储解决方案，特别是SD卡的可靠性和M.2接口的必要性。
• 另一个焦点是Raspberry Pi 5的软件支持问题，特别是对多种操作系统的兼容性。
• 对Raspberry Pi 5的整体存在意义和市场定位存在不同看法，一些人质疑其相对于迷你PC的竞争力。

44707062.article_content:
Will Whang’s RPI5-SDexpress-Hat is a small HAT+ for the Raspberry Pi 5, adding a microSD Express card slot for ultrafast storage, an eject button, and two Qwiic connectors, probably because there was still some spare space on the board…
As a reminder,
microSD Express cards can deliver SSD performance
thanks to the use of of PCIe interface and NVMe commands. The standard was first introduced in 2019, and
even earlier (2018) for full-size SD cards
, but manufacturers have not exactly rushed to release compatible hardware. A major change this year is the launch of the Nintendo Switch 2 portable game console, one of the first mass market devices with a microSD Express slot, and this was partially why Will created the microSD Express HAT+ for the
Raspberry Pi 5
.
RPI5-SDexpress-Hat board specifications:
MCU – WCH
CH32V003
RISC-V microcontroller for hotplugging and unmount
Host interface – PCIe Gen3 x1 FFC connector
Expansion – 2x Qwiic connectors
Misc – Eject button, Power LEDs, Mounted LED
Power Management
5V supply via 40-pin GPIO header (6-pin header used)
1.8V/3.3V fixed output
LP5907 voltage
PAM2306 step-down DC convertor for 1.8V voltage
Dimensions – Small
The good news is that it just works:
Here are some storage benchmarks  using PiBenchmarks.com with the Raspberry Pi 5 configured to use PCIe Gen3 x1:

HDParm                    Disk Read                 631.68 MB/sec
HDParm                    Cached Disk Read          699.12 MB/sec
DD                        Disk Write                169 MB/s
FIO                       4k random read            48761 IOPS (195047 KB/s)
FIO                       4k random write           26290 IOPS (105160 KB/s)
IOZone                    4k read                   22803 KB/s
IOZone                    4k write                  137502 KB/s
IOZone                    4k random read            31366 KB/s
IOZone                    4k random write           178701 KB/s

The read speed is indeed better than a typical microSD card (630MB/s+), but the sustained write speed is closer to a high-end traditional Class A1/A2 microSD card at under 200 MB/s. Random I/IOs are much better, too.
You may wonder why a microcontroller is needed here. As one reader explained in our article about a
microSD Express to M.2 NVMe SSD for the Nintendo Switch 2
, some logic is required (update:
maybe not
):
It will not work without a proper SD handshake and CMD8 command response with PCIe flags as SD host controller needs to enable and reset PCIe side for this to work…
The design is fully open-source with KiCad schematics and BoM available
on GitHub
, where you’ll also find the firmware binary for the
STM8S
CH32V003 MCU, but no source code. The project is based on
Will’s earlier RPi5-CFE-Hat
CFexpress Card hat for Raspberry Pi 5, whose firmware’s source code is available, so it’s probably just a matter of time.
Sadly, having a microSD Express card slot on the Raspberry Pi 5 does not make a lot of sense at this point due to the cost of MicroSD Express card. An M.2 NVMe SSD is cheaper, and so is a CFexpress Type B card. For reference, the Samsung 256GB microSD Express card used in the demo
sells for $59.99 on Amazon
, while a similar SSD goes
for about $25
, and an M.2 SSD in a  CFExpress Type B card is
also slightly cheaper
.
Samsung 256GB microSD EX card
For those reasons, Will will not manufacture the HAT, but the design is released under a permissive MIT license, so anybody could manufacture it if needed. Maybe a microSD Express slot will make sense in a future Raspberry Pi 6, as prices come down.
Update: The article was updated to change STM8S (as in the PDF schematics) to CH32V002 as
reported on X
, and a few other details.

data.title: Show HN: AgentMail – Email infra for AI agents
data.author: Haakam21
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了如何使用AgentMail创建首个收件箱以进行演示。用户可以选择设置用户名（默认为随机）和显示名称（可选）。通过SDK和实时预览功能，用户可以利用代码创建并设置收件箱。具体代码示例如下：使用`client.inboxes.create`方法，指定域名为"agentmail.to"来创建收件箱，并进行演示设置。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一款新型电子邮件代理工具的应用、设计、价格、技术实现及潜在问题的讨论。

不同观点：
• **赞赏设计与执行**：[primitivesuave] 对工具的用户界面设计（尤其是弹出式SDK示例）表示赞赏，认为这是一个创新且执行精良的功能。
• **利用现有工具的讨论**：[loremm] 提到使用Gmail的pubsub功能可以实现类似的网络钩子功能，且免费、低延迟、可扩展，暗示可能无需额外工具。
• **基础设施的挑战与AI助手的潜力**：[tuckerman] 认为处理电子邮件的基础设施非常复杂，但对工具在AI助手中的潜力表示期待，强调AI应使用人类偏好的工具。
• **价格敏感性**：[sauwan] 表示产品的定价对于初创公司较高，建议提供更便宜的选项，如免费的单 inbox 或低价的多 inbox 方案。
• **反垃圾与滥用问题**：[sneurgaonkar] 关注滥用和垃圾邮件问题，并询问是否有集成流行代理框架的计划。
• **对未来需求的预期**：[matt_cogito] 认为虽然目前没有使用需求，但未来可能会需要这样的工具，并指出当前工具在处理电子邮件信息上的不足。

补充讨论：
• **个人项目经验**：[franze] 分享了自己创建类似工具的经验，强调时间管理和记忆功能的重要性，但也提到项目未获得广泛关注。
• **通信模式的未来趋势**：[smpandya] 质疑为何选择基于电子邮件的工具，而不是语音或实时聊天模式，暗示未来趋势可能偏向后者。
• **基础设施与技术实现**：[witnessme] 对产品背后的基础设施工具表示兴趣，并提到利用现有电子邮件基础设施可能减少项目的兴奋感。
• **滥用与垃圾邮件的潜在问题**：[mayas_] 担心如果没有适当的缓解措施，这类工具可能会增加垃圾邮件问题。
• **用户体验与功能实现**：[xinweihe] 提到在尝试使用时遇到等待列表和按钮不可点击的问题，关注用户体验。
• **具体使用场景与用户引导**：[hajrice] 询问了产品在销售场景中的具体使用方式，并提到在注册后缺乏明确的下一步指引。
• **域名注册问题**：[bearcobra] 关注域名注册是否由工具提供或用户自备，以及所有权问题。

争议焦点：
• 定价对于初创公司是否过高。
• 基于电子邮件的工具是否符合未来通信趋势。
• 如何有效应对滥用和垃圾邮件问题。
• 用户在产品使用初期的引导是否足够清晰。

data.title: Mountain of Ink
data.author: neilfrndes
data.article_summary: 本文简要介绍五种Akkerman标准墨水：16号Oranje Boven、17号Staten-Generaal Rood、18号Garuda Rood、19号Rood Haags Pluche和20号Pulchri Pink。这些墨水可在Vanness Pens等零售商处购买。文章提供了墨水的试色，并在Rhodia、Tomoe River和Leuchtturm等纸张上测试了书写效果。干燥时间为40-80秒，中等防水，无洇纸，有一定的阴影效果，其中16号Oranje Boven有金色光泽。与其它品牌墨水进行了颜色对比，16号Oranje Boven最受作者喜爱。文章强调内容和观点均为作者本人，无任何商业推广。

主要讨论点：关于钢笔（尤其是钢笔）的使用体验、优缺点以及相关资源推荐

不同观点：
• **简化钢笔使用**：agambrahma认为人们把钢笔的使用复杂化了。他推荐使用Lamy Safari，并建议只需简单的步骤（如换墨囊或使用转换器）即可大幅改善书写体验，没必要深入研究。
• **钢笔和墨水的深入探索**：ergonaught表示，一些网站帮助他避免了许多不必要的购买，同时也帮助他找到了满意的墨水和钢笔，认为这些资源非常有用。
• **钢笔的 niche 性质和市场现象**：Pinus指出，手写正在变得越来越小众，而使用钢笔更是小众中的小众，但市场上却有大量墨水制造商，他觉得这种现象有些荒谬。
• **钢笔的清洁和设计问题**：cropher提到钢笔使用过程中的清洁问题，尤其是笔握部分容易弄脏，且每次盖上笔帽都会弄脏。他质疑为何没有仅覆盖笔尖的更小笔帽设计。
• **左手书写者的困扰**：voidUpdate作为左撇子，指出钢笔书写容易造成 smudging（污迹），并且尝试多种钢笔后仍觉得便宜的圆珠笔最适合他，因其干燥快且不易污迹。

补充讨论：
• **资源推荐**：
  ◦ calmbonsai推荐了Goulet Pens作为购买钢笔和墨水的好去处。
  ◦ Brajeshwar推荐了YouTube频道Hemingway Jones以及JetPens作为钢笔和文具的资源。
  ◦ bayindirh推荐了Galen Leather作为深入了解钢笔及其相关物品的资源。
  ◦ cosiiine分享了自己使用钢笔进行算法绘图艺术的经验，并推荐了一个相关资源。
  ◦ user_7832提到r/fountainpens subreddit社区，作为获取更多钢笔信息的资源。

• **个人偏好与体验**：
  ◦ st-msl表达了对网站内容的赞赏。
  ◦ charleshan分享了自己根据推荐购买的钢笔和墨水。
  ◦ quirino则表示自己不喜欢钢笔的脆弱性和维护需求，更偏好Kaweco LILIPUT这样的钢笔，认为其更实用且坚固。

• **广告和技术问题**：
  ◦ systemswizard指出网站广告过于干扰，并且其中一个广告提供者会重定向到“Microsoft支持”。

争议焦点：
• **钢笔的实用性与复杂性**：一部分人认为钢笔使用过于复杂且需要维护（如cropher和quirino），而另一部分人则认为只需简单几步即可享受钢笔的乐趣（如agambrahma）。
• **左手书写者的困扰**：voidUpdate作为左撇子，指出钢笔在实际使用中的不便，特别是污迹问题，这与其他右手使用者可能有不同的体验。

44720077.article_content:
Let’s take a look at five
Akkerman standard inks
: 16 Oranje Boven, 17 Staten-Generaal Rood, 18 Garuda Rood, 19 Rood Haags Pluche and 20 Pulchri Pink. You can purchase these inks at a few retailers including
Vanness Pens
.
Swabs:
Left to right:16 Oranje Boven, 17 Staten-Generaal Rood, 18 Garuda Rood, 19 Rood Haags Pluche and 20 Pulchri Pink
Writing samples:
Let's take a look at how the ink behaves on fountain pen friendly papers: Rhodia, Tomoe River, and Leuchtturm.
Dry Time: 40-80 seconds
Water Resistance: Medium
Feathering: None
Show through: Medium
Bleeding: None
Other properties: All five had low-medium shading. Oranje Boven had low gold sheen.
On Walmart Pen + Gear copy paper there was quite a bit of feathering but no bleeding.
Comparison Swabs:
16 Oranje Boven is closest to Sailor Kin-mokusei.
17 Staten-Generaal Rood is similar to Diamine Amaranth.
18 Garuda Rood is close to PenBBS 381 Frosted Leaf in Autumn.
19 Rood Haags Pluche is close to Private Reserve Infinity Red.
20 Pulchri Pink is a little warmer toned than Montblanc Pink.
I used a Taroko Enigma notebook. All five inks had average flows.
Overall, 16 Oranje Boven is my favorite out of the five, but you can’t go wrong with any of them. I like that 16 has some shading and sheen, and is well behaved.
Disclaimer: All photos and opinions are my own. This page does not contain affiliate links, and is not sponsored in any way.

data.title: Telo MT1
data.author: turtleyacht
data.article_summary: TELO Trucks推出全球最高效的电动迷你皮卡MT1，专为城市生活和周末冒险设计。该车在MINI Cooper大小的车身内实现了与Toyota Tacoma相当的载货能力和接近Tesla的续航里程。MT1拥有4门5座，60英寸货箱，可通过中隔板扩展至96英寸，最多可坐8人。配备350英里续航、106 kWh电池和20分钟快充功能。内饰简约实用，采用先进安全技术，如碰撞预测传感器。TELO MT1兼顾实用性与高效能，适合城市和郊外使用。现已开放预订。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：电动小型皮卡车的设计、市场定位、价格以及其与传统皮卡车的比较

不同观点：
• [fumar] 认为现代皮卡车（尤其是2017年后的车型）体积过大，对行人构成威胁，且在城市中使用效率低。他赞赏小型电动皮卡车的设计，认为它们更适合城市和短途使用。
• [baby_souffle] 提供了关于该车型技术细节的讨论，包括车身材料、基于Subaru Ascent的底盘、电池化学成分和博世提供的动力系统。他还提到该车可能不允许大量改装，与Slate车型的开放性形成对比。
• [ThinkBeat] 强调了拥有皮卡车后的实用性，如帮助他人搬运物品，但也指出如果真正需要皮卡车的人，可能不会将这种小型电动皮卡车作为首选，认为它们面向不同市场。
• [sheepscreek] 对小型电动皮卡车的设计表示赞赏，但担心其商业可行性和市场需求。他提到特斯拉有能力生产这类车但尚未这么做，可能是因为生产成本和市场需求问题。
• [programmertote] 支持小型电动皮卡车的设计，认为其是对现代过大卡车的改进，但也担心内饰材料的耐用性。
• [markbao] 批评了某些电动汽车公司将车设计得像玩具，比如这款车看起来像高尔夫球车，并建议参考日本Kei卡车的设计以提高市场接受度。
• [numpad0] 通过具体尺寸比较，指出该车比日本Kei车大，但比传统皮卡车小，并提到车斗长度较短可能影响实用性。
• [rsync] 对车内设计表示失望，认为缺乏物理控制按钮，尽管保留了转向柱上的控制杆。
• [world2vec] 提到Doug DeMuro的评测视频，间接提供了外部评测的观点。
• [siva7] 认为该车外观不吸引人，更偏好传统福特皮卡车。
• [levocardia] 虽然不喜欢该车的外观设计，但支持EV公司尝试不同美学设计，认为多样化比千篇一律更好。
• [999900000999] 认为该车价格过高，违背了Slate车型试图以低于20K价格进入市场的初衷。
• [grokx] 提到与类似市场目标的车型"bagnole"进行比较，提供了另一种市场视角。
• [jama211] 认为该车实际上是标准尺寸的卡车，只是现代卡车普遍过大，使得这款车显得小。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是该车的市场定位，一些人认为它是小型城市车，而另一些人认为它不能替代传统皮卡车的功能。
• 另一个值得注意的点是价格问题，尤其是与Slate车型原本设想的低于20K价格目标的偏离。
• 内饰设计和材料耐用性也被广泛讨论，部分评论者对其设计简约和材料选择提出质疑。

data.title: Why Exercise Is a Miracle Drug
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了锻炼作为“神奇药物”的独特效果，援引斯坦福大学医学院院长Euan Ashley的观点，称锻炼是迄今为止最有效的医学“发明”，其对身体多组织和系统的益处无法通过任何药物复制。实验显示，锻炼能显著改善器官和分子系统，增强免疫力、减少炎症并预防疾病。此外，研究表明，锻炼还能显著提高癌症患者的生存率。文章还讨论了全球健康支出对拯救生命的重大影响，指出美国国际开发署的项目通过少量预算拯救了约9000万人的生命，特别是在防治艾滋病、疟疾等疾病方面成效显著。文章呼吁继续投资全球健康项目，认为这是极具道德回报的举措。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：锻炼的益处、运气与责任感、锻炼与健康因果关系的科学证据、锻炼的形式与选择

不同观点：
• [bad_username] 认为，出生在富裕国家是纯粹的幸运，无需为此感到内疚或需要“回报”社会。他们强调感激和积极行动，但认为内疚感是不健康且无意义的。
• [sharkweek] 分享了个人体验，指出锻炼对情绪的积极影响，特别是通过骑自行车等活动可以显著改善心情和身体健康。
• [bob129] 引用了作者Daniel Lieberman的观点，指出人类进化过程中并未专门进化出锻炼的需求，但我们的身体结构却非常适合长时间跑步等活动。
• [LeftHandPath] 强调了锻炼和社交对心理健康的重要性，并提到志愿服务作为一种锻炼和社交活动，具有很高的回报。
• [starchild3001] 提供了科学证据，指出锻炼与全因死亡率之间的关系在随机对照试验和观察性研究中的结果有所不同，强调锻炼对特定高风险群体的显著益处。

补充讨论：
• [datameta] 强调了步行作为锻炼的一种形式，并指出持续性比偶尔的高强度努力更有效。
• [bmacho] 补充了[bob129]的观点，指出尽管人类未进化出专门的锻炼需求，但身体的许多机制假设我们定期锻炼。
• [glitchc] 对“道德投资”概念提出质疑，并质疑政府为何要进行此类投资，特别是对外国的投资。
• [socalgal2] 指出文章标题图片与内容不符，认为瑜伽不属于有氧健身或力量训练，但个人对瑜伽并无贬低之意。
• [broof] 分享了个人经历，指出失业后开始锻炼的习惯对健康和心理健康的巨大改善。
• [softwaredoug] 警告过度锻炼和营养不足的风险，特别是提到自己在年轻时因过度锻炼和间歇性禁食导致的健康问题。
• [SeanAnderson] 对文章的结构和标题提出质疑，认为文章内容混杂，未能清晰反映标题所暗示的内容。
• [endoblast] 分享了个人日常散步的经验，并寻找一种有趣且低风险的上肢锻炼方式。
• [voat] 提出未来是否可能通过生化手段激活锻炼带来的健康益处，而无需实际进行锻炼。
• [otterpro] 分享了个人通过增加日常生活中的体力活动来模拟过去必要的体力劳动，从而改善健康的经验。

• 是否应该为幸运的出生背景感到内疚并需要“回报”社会。[bad_username]认为没有必要，而其他讨论中隐含的内疚感可能推动人们积极行动。

• 锻炼的形式和选择，包括步行、瑜伽、力量训练和日常体力活动的价值。

Welcome back to The Sunday Morning Post, this newsletter’s weekly rundown of the most interesting and important stuff I’m seeing in science, technology, economics, and beyond. Comments are open. Leave tips, papers, studies, tweets, posts, questions, and graphs in the comments, if you think they’ll serve for future editions.
We’re Never Going to Invent a Drug That’s Better Than Exercise
Euan Ashley has
claimed
that exercise is the “single most potent medical invention” ever—more broadly effective than any medicine discovered in the natural world or devised in a laboratory. In 2025, this is the sort of rah-rah sentiment about working out that one might associate with a Make America Healthy Again ambassador rather than, say, the chair of medicine at Stanford University. So, what makes Ashley’s claim significant is that he
is
the chair of medicine at Stanford University.
Subscribe
Last year, Ashley and a large team of scientists conducted an elaborate experiment on the effects of exercise on the mammalian body. In one test, Ashley put rats on tiny treadmills, worked them out for weeks, and cut into them to investigate how their organs and vessels responded to the workout compared to a control group of more sedentary rodents.
1
The results were spectacular. Exercise transformed just about every tissue and molecular system that Ashley and his co-authors studied—not just the muscles and heart, but also the liver, adrenal glands, fat, and immune system.
When I asked Ashley if it was possible to design a drug that mimicked the observed effects of exercise, he was emphatic that, no, this was not possible. The benefits of exercise seem too broad for any one therapy to mimic. To a best approximation, aerobic fitness and weight-training seem to increase our metabolism, improve mitochondrial function, fortify our immune system, reduce inflammation, improve tissue-specific adaptations, and protect against disease.
The latest entry in the Exercise Is Magic file comes from
the New England Journal of Medicine
. In a recent study, 900 cancer patients who had undergone surgery on their advanced colon cancer were randomly assigned to two groups. One group got a “structured exercise program.” They went to behavioral support sessions and attended supervised exercise classes every few weeks for several years. The other group received only basic information about diet and health.
Compared to the control group, the exercise group saw “significantly” more years without cancer, a 7 percentage point increase in the overall survival rate after 8 years, and a dramatic reduction in new primary cancers. Exercise, it seems, doesn’t just prevent disease; it can also save your life after you get sick.
The author Daniel Lieberman
has put it well
: Exercise is healthy and rewarding even though it’s something we never evolved to do. To adapt to the physical ease of the modern world, people invented a variety of weight-resistant devices and bodily movements that allow today’s population to simulate the arduous tasks that were once necessary to make it through a life, and this strange pantomime of physical stress seems to do more for us at a molecular level than any therapy or intervention in the history of medicine.
2
How to Save 100 Million Lives
Soon after overseeing cuts to more than 80 percent of programs at the United States Agency for International Development, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in remarks in July that USAID “has little to show since the end of the Cold War.” In the field of global health, this analysis may be off by about 100 million.
In June, The Lancet
published
an evaluation of 20 years of USAID funding by a team of global researchers from Brazil, Spain, Mozambique, and the United States. They calculated that US global health and development spending has spared about 90 million deaths in low-income countries, including:
25 million lives saved from HIV/AIDS
11 million from diarrheal disease
9 million from lower respiratory infections
9 million from "neglected" tropical diseases, such as dengue and river blindness
8 million from malaria
5 million from tuberculosis
2 million from nutritional deficiencies
All this was achieved with a program that accounts for about 0.8 percent of the federal budget and about 1/400th of America’s total national spending. This is a staggering return on moral investment.

About Great Question
Great Question is on a mission to help businesses build better products by making customer research fast, easy, and scalable. We’re a Series A B2B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by leading brands like Gusto, Miro, Brex, and Canva.
Our all-in-one research platform enables teams to recruit participants, run interviews and surveys, and analyze insights — all in one place. As we enter the era of AI, we’re pioneering automated qualitative analysis to help teams turn customer feedback into actionable insights faster than ever.
We’re a remote-first, customer-obsessed team committed to helping product teams deeply understand and serve their users. Learn more at
greatquestion.co
.
About The Role
Great Question is growing fast — and we’re ready to bring on our first Director of Engineering to help scale our team, systems, and technical foundation for what’s next. You’ll help turn a strong product and ambitious roadmap into a durable, high-performing org.
You’ll work closely with our CTO to turn vision into execution at scale, while building a high-trust, high-impact environment that supports both rapid growth and technical excellence.
Scope & Priorities
1. Org-Wide Delivery & Operational Excellence
Own the systems that power engineering delivery across all teams — from roadmap execution to internal alignment:
Lead delivery across 4+ squads and 20+ engineers with consistent velocity, quality, and accountability
Evolve the release process for scale: coordinated launches, post-release ownership, rollback playbooks
Improve efficiency through cost awareness, tooling strategy, and cross-functional workflows
Build and maintain visibility across squads without heavy process overhead - optimise for the teams time on tools
2. Technical Leadership & Platform Architecture
Uphold strong engineering standards while empowering teams to move fast with clarity and confidence:
Define and scale technical quality across the org (instrumentation, testing, SLAs, postmortems)
Partner with the CTO and shape architectural direction and platform investment
Ensure strategic technical decisions are reviewed, documented, and socialized org-wide
Advocate for “right-fidelity” development: when to build for speed vs. stability vs. scale
3. People Leadership & Org Design
Design and lead a high-performing engineering organization that can scale with the company:
Align headcount and engineering investment with organisational priorities
Structure teams to match product surface area, revenue contribution, platform ownership, and growth goals
Attract and retain top-tier talent; maintain a strong hiring bar across all levels
Develop IC's into EMs, and EM's into Directors
Define career frameworks that support high performance, tenure and equity
4. Cross-Functional Execution
Be the connective tissue between Engineering and the rest of the business:
Partner with Product, Success, and Design to align roadmaps and solve the right problems
Create shared planning and prioritization processes that improve focus and reduce thrash
Translate engineering investments into business impact — and help others across the org do the same
Set expectations across departments around timelines, trade-offs, and capacity
5. Culture, Strategy & Executive Partnership
Scale engineering culture intentionally — without losing autonomy, quality, or accountability:
Model calm, clear decision-making and foster a high-trust, low-drama environment
Connect engineers to customer outcomes and business rationale
Partner closely with the CTO to operationalize long-term vision, enabling the CTO to focus on technical differentiation and innovation
Contribute meaningfully to exec-level planning, headcount strategy, and product direction
About You
Proven success leading engineering teams in high-growth B2B SaaS environments, ideally having scaled from Series A to Series B/C and beyond
Experienced org builder; can scale systems and teams through ambiguity and change
Deeply credible with senior engineers; understands architectural trade-offs at scale.
Proven track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining high-performing leaders and ICs.
Trusted partner to Product, Success, and Design; translates technical decisions into business impact.
Low-ego, high-accountability. Balances urgency and empathy. Trusted by engineers and execs alike.
Passionate about the opportunity around AI
Benefits
Competitive salary,
equity and a benefits package
High-impact work
on meaningful, challenging projects — with the opportunity to lead and scale a fast-growing team in a dynamic environment
Fully remote
by default, with optional in-person meetups in your area if that’s your thing

data.title: The /o in Ruby regex stands for "oh the humanity "
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了Ruby中正则表达式使用`/o`修饰符引发的一个隐蔽问题。作者在代码审查中发现一个`Matcher`类，其`matches_any?`方法使用正则表达式匹配输入字符串。最初测试通过，但后来发现无论输入什么值，结果都始终一致。经过排查，发现问题源于`/o`修饰符，它会导致正则表达式在首次插值后被缓存，后续不再重新插值。作者通过查阅文档和分析VM字节码，最终解决了问题并理解了其内部机制。这个修饰符本意是优化，但在此场景中引发了难以察觉的错误。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Perl 和 Ruby 中正则表达式的 `/o` 修饰符及其相关文档和设计选择

不同观点：
• **支持观点：**
  - 一些用户（如 cbsmith）表示，作为有经验的 Perl 程序员，他们理解 `/o` 修饰符的作用，并认为其行为是明确的。
  - kazinator 通过类比 C++ 和 POSIX 中的类似机制，解释 `/o` 修饰符的行为，并认为这是合理的设计。
  - phoronixrly 认为这是一个有趣的功能，表示喜欢这种深入探讨。

• **反对观点：**
  - fanf2 批评 Ruby 文档不够清晰，尤其是将 `/o` 称为“插值模式”具有误导性，并引用了 Perl 文档作为对比，指出 Perl 的文档更加明确。
  - tialaramex 认为 `/o` 修饰符是一种“footgun”（容易被误用导致问题的功能），主张编程语言应尽量避免这种设计，因为它们容易导致难以察觉的错误。
  - Joker_vD 表示不理解 `/o` 修饰符的设计逻辑，认为如果需要插值就应该每次重新插值，以避免潜在的错误，并质疑该功能的价值。

• **中立或调侃观点：**
  - riffraff 提到 `END {}` 也是继承自 Perl，可能最早来源于 awk，但没有深入讨论。
  - jononor 以幽默方式将 `/o` 形象化为一个被长棍击打头部的表情符号。
  - IshKebab 简短评论称这种情况在 Ruby 中很常见。
  - zer00eyz 引用经典的“正则表达式问题”笑话，暗示对使用复杂正则表达式功能的怀疑态度。

补充讨论：
• **技术细节和类比：**
  - kazinator 通过 C++ 中的 `static` 变量和 POSIX 的 `pthread_once` 函数类比，说明 `/o` 修饰符的行为逻辑，强调其“一次性初始化”的特点。
  
• **争议焦点：**
  - 争议的核心在于 `/o` 修饰符是否容易导致误用和错误。支持者认为其行为明确，反对者则认为这是一个危险的 footgun，容易引发难以察觉的 bug。

总结：讨论围绕 `/o` 修饰符的作用、文档描述的准确性及其设计是否合理展开。支持者多为有经验的 Perl 程序员，而反对者则关注其潜在的误用风险。

Source:

Hi there! Do you like Regex? Do you like performance? Do you like creating confounding bugs for yourself rooted in the mechanics of the Ruby VM itself?
If you said yes to all of the above, have I got a feature for you!
But first, let’s start with a story.
The cliffs of insanity
I was recently reviewing some code, and part of the functionality was about matching. A class took an array of strings, and you could call a method to see if an input matched part of any of the strings. Stripped down, it was effectively the following code:
class Matcher
def initialize(matchables)
@matchables = matchables
end
def matches_any?(input)
@matchables.any? { |m| m.match?(/#{input}/io) }
end
end
I
know
there are some of you reading this code and thinking “does this really need a regex?”, “couldn’t it just use
include?
and some downcasing?”, “does this even need to exist?”, etc, etc. I see you, I hear you, I’d probably think the same, and I
promise
you the specifics of this method aren’t that important.
Functionally, the code looked
ok
to me. I knew what
/i
was (a regex in
case-insensitive mode
), but I didn’t recognize
/o
. It didn’t seem critically important to lookup yet. Tests were not exhaustive but were green, and so I went to run the code in a console:
Matcher
.
new(
[
"Ruby!"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"ruby"
)
=>
true
Matcher
.
new(
[
"Ruby!"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"something else"
)
=>
true
Matcher
.
new(
[
"Ruby!"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"javascript"
)
=>
true
Well, that seemed broken. Assuming it was a bug, I looked at the code to see what was wrong. But nothing stuck out. The code
seemed
ok, and simple:
@matchables.any? |m| m.match?(/#{input/io) }
So I deconstructed the code and ran it directly, outside the class:
[
"Ruby!"
].
any? {
|
m
|
m
.
match?(
/ruby/io
) }
=>
true
[
"Ruby!"
].
any? {
|
m
|
m
.
match?(
/something else/io
) }
=>
false
Even weirder. Run directly, it ran as expected. What if I started a new console, and ran the original class in a different order?
Matcher
.
new(
[
"Ruby!"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"something else"
)
=>
false
Matcher
.
new(
[
"Ruby!"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"ruby"
)
=>
false
Matcher
.
new(
[
"something else"
]
)
.
matches_any?(
"Ruby!"
)
=>
true
Well, that was interesting. It seems like whatever value I sent to
matches_any?
was cached for every run after that point, even for
brand new objects
.
I looked through the class again. There was no weird memoization. No class-level variables. No thread locals. I was instantiating the class each time I ran
matches_any?
. I was out of ideas for the predictable things that cause unpredictable results. What else was there?
/o the humanity!
With nothing else to investigate, I finally looked up the docs for what the
/o
regex modifier does.
/o
is referred to as “Interpolation mode”, which sounded pretty harmless. The Ruby docs have a succinct section on the expected behavior:
https://ruby-doc.org/3.4.1/Regexp.html#class-Regexp-label-Interpolation+Mode
Modifier o means that the first time a literal regexp with interpolations is encountered, the generated Regexp object is saved and used for all future evaluations of that literal regexp
Just reading that, I still wasn’t sure I’d expect what I was seeing. It almost sounded like internally Ruby would cache
each
different interpolation that comes through. As if it would maybe reuse an internal regex if the same string value was interpolated. They provide a code example that makes it a little clearer:
def letters; sleep 5; /[A-Z][a-z]/; end
words = %w[abc def xyz]
start = Time.now
words.each {|word| word.match(/\A[#{letters}]+\z/) }
Time.now - start # => 15.0174892
start = Time.now
words.each {|word| word.match(/\A[#{letters}]+\z/o) }
Time.now - start # => 5.0010866
The
letters
method in the first example is called three times. One time for each iteration, as expected, taking 15 seconds total.
In the second example, the code iterates three times, but the
letters
method is called
once
, taking 5 seconds total.
Knowing that, I went back to the original code with new eyes:
class
Matcher
def
initialize
(matchables)
@matchables
=
matchables
end
def
matches_any?
(input)
@matchables
.
any? {
|
m
|
m
.
match?(
/
#{
input
}
/io
# This is run once, _ever_
)
}
end
end
What that meant for me is that the regular expression inside of
matches_any?
was interpolating the
first value it
ever
receives
. Past that point the regex
never interpolated another value
.
As it turned out, the developer had read about it as a potential regex optimization. It seemed harmless enough, so they added it. Now that I knew why I was hitting the issue, I removed the
/o
and everything started working properly.
But it still was not clear to me
how
this was possible. What in the world is Ruby doing internally? Let’s figure it out together.
Inside the VM
Sometimes the only way to understand a behavior in Ruby is to drop a bit lower. Let’s disassemble the code into Ruby VM byte code, to see if it gives us any clues
44767959.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了Ruby中正则表达式使用`/o`修饰符引发的一个隐蔽问题。作者在代码审查中发现一个`Matcher`类，其`matches_any?`方法使用正则表达式匹配输入字符串。最初测试通过，但后来发现无论输入什么值，结果都始终一致。经过排查，发现问题源于`/o`修饰符，它会导致正则表达式在首次插值后被缓存，后续不再重新插值。作者通过查阅文档和分析VM字节码，最终解决了问题并理解了其内部机制。这个修饰符本意是优化，但在此场景中引发了难以察觉的错误。
44767959.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Perl 和 Ruby 中正则表达式的 `/o` 修饰符及其相关文档和设计选择

不同观点：
• **支持观点：**
  - 一些用户（如 cbsmith）表示，作为有经验的 Perl 程序员，他们理解 `/o` 修饰符的作用，并认为其行为是明确的。
  - kazinator 通过类比 C++ 和 POSIX 中的类似机制，解释 `/o` 修饰符的行为，并认为这是合理的设计。
  - phoronixrly 认为这是一个有趣的功能，表示喜欢这种深入探讨。

• **反对观点：**
  - fanf2 批评 Ruby 文档不够清晰，尤其是将 `/o` 称为“插值模式”具有误导性，并引用了 Perl 文档作为对比，指出 Perl 的文档更加明确。
  - tialaramex 认为 `/o` 修饰符是一种“footgun”（容易被误用导致问题的功能），主张编程语言应尽量避免这种设计，因为它们容易导致难以察觉的错误。
  - Joker_vD 表示不理解 `/o` 修饰符的设计逻辑，认为如果需要插值就应该每次重新插值，以避免潜在的错误，并质疑该功能的价值。

• **中立或调侃观点：**
  - riffraff 提到 `END {}` 也是继承自 Perl，可能最早来源于 awk，但没有深入讨论。
  - jononor 以幽默方式将 `/o` 形象化为一个被长棍击打头部的表情符号。
  - IshKebab 简短评论称这种情况在 Ruby 中很常见。
  - zer00eyz 引用经典的“正则表达式问题”笑话，暗示对使用复杂正则表达式功能的怀疑态度。

补充讨论：
• **技术细节和类比：**
  - kazinator 通过 C++ 中的 `static` 变量和 POSIX 的 `pthread_once` 函数类比，说明 `/o` 修饰符的行为逻辑，强调其“一次性初始化”的特点。
  
• **争议焦点：**
  - 争议的核心在于 `/o` 修饰符是否容易导致误用和错误。支持者认为其行为明确，反对者则认为这是一个危险的 footgun，容易引发难以察觉的 bug。

总结：讨论围绕 `/o` 修饰符的作用、文档描述的准确性及其设计是否合理展开。支持者多为有经验的 Perl 程序员，而反对者则关注其潜在的误用风险。

data.title: Online Collection of Keygen Music
data.author: mifydev
data.article_summary: Keygen Music Lib（keygenmusic.tk）是一个提供keygen音乐播放的在线平台，支持`.mod`、`.xm`、`.s3m`、`.it`等格式。该平台目前为β15版本，修复了Firefox兼容性问题，并不包含任何非法内容。网站提供播放控制、收藏夹、随机播放等功能，由Mikhailo Onikiienko开发，使用多种开源库如libopenmpt和chiptune2.js等。若浏览器不支持AudioContext，建议使用Firefox。联系方式为keygenmusic.tk{at}outlook.com。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕破解软件的“键gen音乐”及其相关文化的讨论

不同观点：
• **怀旧与情感价值**：
  - fortydegrees：对破解团队和其作品怀有敬意，认为这些作品结合了智力的挑战和艺术表达，尤其是独特的UI设计和芯片音乐（chiptune）。
  - cantalopes：表达了对收集键gen的怀念，认为这些作品一直很棒。
  - markus_zhang：喜欢键gen音乐的设计和多样性，但希望有循环播放的选项。

• **技术与法律问题**：
  - joecool1029：对.tk域名的可持续性表示担忧，提到自己曾因Meta的诉讼无法续期域名。
  - burnt-resistor：建议有人应该整理并发布一个包含键gen音乐的大型种子文件，但怀疑是否会有平台长期托管。
  - dogcow：对网站可能因.tk域名的不稳定性而消失表示担忧。

• **音乐与文化影响**：
  - glimshe：认为键gen音乐像一种电子音乐流派，并询问是否有现代乐器制作类似风格的音乐。
  - djeastm：指出键gen音乐音量通常过大。
  - EDM115：分享了一个YouTube视频链接，讨论键gen音乐作为“网络盗版原声带”。
  - pie_flavor：分享了一个键gen音乐的翻唱和混音专辑链接。

• **相关资源与推荐**：
  - darknavi：提到一个Sony Vegas 9破解的怀旧视频。
  - mdtrooper：推荐了一个2006年诞生的在线游戏音乐电台。
  - daneel_w：提到Modland作为一个权威的芯片音乐合集，已有超过20年历史。

补充讨论：
• **幽默与调侃**：
  - irusensei：以幽默的方式提到打开网站后Windows激活水印消失，接着表明自己不使用Windows。
  
• **技术体验**：
  - officeplant：对网站的音乐合集在老旧设备上的运行表现提出看法，指出其ThinkPad被占用大量资源。

争议焦点：
• 主要集中在**技术与法律问题**，特别是.tk域名的可持续性和键gen资源托管的合法性与可行性。
